content:
Since \((2n-19)^2-(2k)^2=757\), factor:

\[
(2n-19-2k)(2n-19+2k)=757.
\]

Now \(757\) is prime, so its factor pairs are \((1,757)\) and \((-1,-757)\).

For \((1,757)\):

\[
(2n-19-2k)+(2n-19+2k)=1+757=758
\]

\[
4n-38=758 \implies 4n=796 \implies n=199.
\]

For \((-1,-757)\):

\[
4n-38=-758 \implies 4n=-720 \implies n=-180,
\]

which is not positive.

Thus the only positive integer is

\[
\boxed{199}.
\]
